anim_categories._source: souls/moves.py constants (ATTACK 3000-3499, STAGGER 3500-3599, HIT_STUN 2000-2099, DOWNED 9900-9999, GUARD_BROKEN 9600, FALLING 1500/1550/121500); dormant 9000-9099 (duel.py/_awake_anim); idle = -1 or null

distance_bins_m._source: weapon reach ~1.3-1.6 m (weapons.py), reflex THREAT_R 2.5, crowd/separation 4 m, SHOT_NEAR_R 6 m (duel.py)

near_count.definition: number of snap.chars with team in {6,7,24,25,27,33} (telemetry.Snapshot.hostile), hp>0, horizontal distance to snap.player < 4.0 m (target included)

lookup.tie_break: higher overall train frequency of the rule, then rule name ascending

macro_f1.primary_class_set: classes with >=10 true scenes AND >=3 runs in that eval set (fixed before evaluation)
macro_f1.secondary_class_set: all classes with >=1 true scene in that eval set (reference)
macro_f1.zero_division: precision of a class never predicted = 0; F1 = 0 when P+R = 0

B_no_dirty_duel.note: train rebuilt without the run whose uncommitted diff changes duel.py
